questions.prompt: When should a parent be checked for deletion?

choices.label: After both child subtrees have been processed.
choices.feedback: Removing children can turn their parent into a new leaf that must also be checked.

choices.label: Before processing either child subtree.
choices.feedback: Removing children can turn their parent into a new leaf that must also be checked.

choices.label: Only before any nodes in the tree have been deleted.
choices.feedback: Removing children can turn their parent into a new leaf that must also be checked.

questions.prompt: Which current nodes should be deleted?

choices.label: Nodes with the target value and no remaining children.
choices.feedback: The problem removes target-valued leaves, not target-valued internal nodes or leaves with other values.

choices.label: Every node with the target value.
choices.feedback: The problem removes target-valued leaves, not target-valued internal nodes or leaves with other values.

choices.label: Every leaf, regardless of its value.

questions.prompt: How should a deleted subtree be represented to its parent?

choices.label: Return its original reference unchanged.
